steps.label: Evaluate L at both points
steps.margin_note: First mark. Write L for the left-hand side of the line, then put each of the two points into it. L₁₁ and L₂₂ are the two values obtained.

recall.must_convey: That L is evaluated at both given points, giving L₁₁ and L₂₂.
accept: put both points into the left hand side of the line
L one one and L two two are the values at the two points
evaluate the expression at A and at B
rendu points ni L lo pettali
find L eleven and L twenty two

steps.why: The sign of each value says which side of the line that point is on, and the ratio of the two values is what the section formula reduces to.
common_mistakes: Using the right-hand side instead of the whole expression set to zero.
Substituting the coordinates the wrong way round.

steps.label: Write the ratio
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The required ratio is −L₁₁ : L₂₂ = −(−7) : 14 = 1 : 2. That is POSITIVE, so the division is internal. A negative ratio would mean external division, which is a real answer and not an error.

recall.must_convey: That the ratio is −L₁₁ : L₂₂, giving 1 : 2.
accept: the ratio is minus L one one to L two two
put a minus on the first value and write the ratio
minus L eleven ratio L twenty two

steps.why: The sign of the ratio says how the line meets the segment: a POSITIVE ratio means it cuts between the two points (internal division), a negative one means it meets the segment produced (external). Here the ratio works out positive, so this line divides internally.
common_mistakes: Dropping the minus sign in front of L₁₁.
Reporting a negative ratio as if it were an error and flipping its sign.
Calling this division external — the ratio here is positive, so it is internal.
